en: The Card Key opened the door!
The door is locked. It takes a card to open it.
Ah, it's you again. We meet once more. The president and I are discussing a business deal.
Silph Co. will hand over its Master Ball to Team Rocket, and you will keep out of it.
Or will you? Very well. I'll make sure you never interfere again!
Arrgh! I lose again?! Blast it all... You ruined our plans for Silph Co.
But Team Rocket will never fall! I'll be waiting for you, child. Remember that.
Thank you, my young friend! You saved Silph Co. from Team Rocket. I can't thank you enough.
Please accept this as a token of our gratitude. You won't find another anywhere.
That's our secret prototype, the Master Ball. It will catch any wild Pokémon without fail.
The Master Ball is the only one of its kind. Use it wisely!
